[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Stenberk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served in the [[Danteel City Police]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Danteel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Carisica Vanq]] on Danteel, Stenberk led several [[Officer/Legends|officers]] into the [[High Card Casino]], to investigate whether a [[Tchine]] statue that had been offered as a prize in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament had been stolen from Vanq. However, shortly after his arrival, Stenberk received word that Vanq's Tchine had been found in a vault on [[Carisica Vanq's estate|her estate]], and he and his party departed from the [[Casino/Legends|casino]]. Several minutes later, a [[Cam droid/Legends|camera droid]] recorded a confession by the casino's business manager [[Darim Chumu]] of involvement in Vanq's death, and Stenberk returned to the High Card and apprehended Chumu.
